title: model.request payload
description: Digest of the exact message list handed to the model for one invocation (ADR-010, OBS-02/D2). Full text lives on the message projection and prior journal events; this event only records reconstructable fingerprints. v3 is emitted by the observed model-call boundary before the provider is invoked and joins call_id with its usage samples and call.finished closure.

selected_tools.description: Tool names bound for this model call (v3: actual bound tools; v1/v2: run selection).

preamble_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the leading system preamble.

context_view.description: Immutable ContextHost View identity selected for this request; content is not embedded.

call_id.description: Opaque per-invocation identity shared by this call's model.usage samples and model.call.finished closure (v3).

mode.description: Invocation mode observed at the model boundary (v3).

provider.description: Provider identity resolved for this call (v3).

model.description: Model identity resolved for this call (v3).

source.description: Route attribution: chat main leg, child run leg, compaction summary, or cache maintenance call (v3).
